newsitem.title: FINLAND: YIT SEES PROFIT IN THIRD TERTIAL.
newsitem.headline: YIT SEES PROFIT IN THIRD TERTIAL.

text.p: Finnish construction group YIT-Yhtyma Oy said in a statement on Monday it expected its result for the third tertial of 1996 to be profit.
"The group result for the last tertial of 1996 is expected to be a profit," YIT said.
YIT's January-August profit before extraordinary items and taxes rose to 102 million markka from five million in the first eight months of 1995.
YIT also said it expected its full-year 1996 net sales to rise to about five billion markka instead of the budgeted 4.75 billion. YIT's 1995 net sales were 3.92 billion markka.
